citation: City of Chicago, Department of Planning and Development. Individual Landmarks (Chicago Data Portal dataset uct4-hrvh), landmark site polygons, valid 2026-04-17; retrieved 2026-11-16.
rights_note: City of Chicago open data, published under the Data Portal's terms of use.
note: MODERN control, not historical evidence: the City's own polygon for each designated landmark site, in WGS84. Used by the Today window's registration (data/modern/landmark_sites.json) to say where a site named in this dataset stands on today's ground. Nothing in a period layer is placed from it.
